exclusion_detail: The abstract names three compounds equally ('compounds 14a, 14b and 24a with improved activity against MTb.H37Rv') and no single best/lead compound; there is no single main follow-up compound either (7n is highlighted for logD/solubility, 'selected compounds' for CYP). Independently, each candidate route (14a, 14b: 5 steps in Scheme 2; 24a: 5 steps in Scheme 4; hit 1 and 7n: 5 steps in Scheme 1) exceeds 4 reactions, so no choice would have produced a route.

lead.label: none (14a, 14b, 24a named together)
lead.why: Abstract: 'A scaffold hopping approach was used to identify compounds 14a, 14b and 24a with improved activity against MTb.H37Rv.'

notes: Looked at all series: Scheme 1 (hit 1, 7a-7n) is 5 steps from commercial diethyl pyrazole-3,5-dicarboxylate (alkylation, azide, Staudinger cyclisation, AlMe3 amidation, N-benzylation); Scheme 2 (14a/b) 'over five steps'; Scheme 3 (18a/b) 6 steps; Scheme 4 (24a/b) 'five steps'. None is 4 or fewer, hence other_qualifying_compounds is empty.
